title: Fathom
description: A GPU deep-zoom Mandelbrot & Julia explorer. Emulated double precision reaches ~1e13; a perturbation engine (BigInt reference orbit + float32 deltas with rebasing) then dives past 1e28. Stripe-average & orbit-trap colouring, normal-map relief lighting, interior shading, progressive rendering, an auto-dive, distance-estimation outlines, and shareable deep links.
